policy.description: Three deterministic micro-model scenario re-sims (not finish-time ratio stretch). Coherent model per PR C (#483): C1 flat-equivalent GAP from history distance+gain, C2 Riegel endurance scaling, C3 shape-only (renormalized) fatigue, C4 full physiological M(g) at grade-cost blend 1.0. Cold-start GAP 10:00/mi. Regenerate with scripts/regen-estimate-bands.ts after any model change.
policy.conservative: GAP×1.06, γ1×1.35, γ2×1.4, altitude penalty×1.15 (γ reshapes only; finish spread from GAP+altitude)
policy.aggressive: GAP×0.94, γ1×0.75, γ2×0.7, altitude penalty×0.9 (γ reshapes only; finish spread from GAP+altitude)
policy.expected: Primary finish — equal to expectedFinishElapsedSeconds / expectedFinishAt
policy.coldStart: Same scenario knobs; expected finish uses GAP 10:00/mi + full grade model (blend 1.0) + course mesh + shape-only fatigue
policy.scheduleBaseline: Crew schedule moving-time / plan-of-record uses expected finish only; bands are informational.
